mapping.draft_py:
# Brineborn Cutthroat: "Flash" (compiled) +
#   "Whenever you cast a spell during an opponent's turn, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature."
trig = TriggeredAbility(
    event=CastSpellEvent(
        filter=FAnd(children=()),
        actor=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
    ),
    condition=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TURN_OF, who=ControllerRef.OPPONENT),
    effect=A(Verb.PUT_COUNTER, {
        'count': QConst(value=1),
        'counter_kind': CounterKind.PLUS_1_PLUS_1,
        'target': Selector(
            count=QConst(value=1),
            mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
            filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
        ),
    }),
)
abilities = [trig, *compiled]

clauses.clause: Whenever you cast a spell during an opponent's turn, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
clauses.ir: abilities[0] (event = you cast any spell; condition TURN_OF opponent)

clauses.evidence: Trace: keywords +FLASH, but every cast is in your own main phase and the opponent's-turn stimulus puts the card in with MOVE_ZONE, not a cast. Pack brineborn_cutthroat_opp_turn_cast.json PASS: cast on the opponent's turn succeeds (control run: non-flash Pirate's Cutlass and Raise the Past are refused there, so the window is enforced).

clauses.clause: Whenever you cast a spell during an opponent's turn, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
clauses.evidence: Trace: [you cast an instant or sorcery (Crash Through)] and [you cast a creature (Aegis Turtle)] on YOUR turn queue trigger [0] but no counter is placed (condition TURN_OF OPPONENT false) - the negative case is right. Positive case never happens on the board. Packs: brineborn_cutthroat_opp_turn_cast.json PASS (on the opponent's turn you cast Goblin Firebomb: exactly one counter, 2/1 -> 3/2); brineborn_cutthroat_opponent_casts.json PASS (two spells the opponent casts on its own turn give neither copy a counter).
